dct_title_s: Landslide impact analysis in Pandanarum Sub-district, Banjarnegara Regency, Jawa Tengah Province, Indonesia as of 18 & 19 November 2025
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: LS20251118IDN** This map illustrates satellite-detected landslides in Pandanarum Sub-district, Banjarnegara Regency, Jawa Tengah Province, Indonesia as observed from a Sentinel-2 and Chaohu-1images acquired on 18 and 19 November 2025. Within the analysed area of 500 hectares about 30 hectares of landslide scars were observed. UNITAR-UNOSAT identified about 70 damaged buildings and 60 potentially affected buildings. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
